description: ROM Ali Combat Combo Chains, 6-Cartwheel Super Finisher & Ripple Stun Callback

routines.name: ali_rapid_spin_facing_rotation
routines.purpose: Calculates Ali 360-degree facing direction (3, 2, 1, 0) at frames 4, 8, 12, 16

routines.name: ali_combo_chain_evaluator
routines.purpose: Evaluates command motions and button transitions between Combo Hit 1 (anim 0x0A, state 8) and Combo Hit 2 (anim 0x3A, state 10)

routines.name: ali_combo_flurry_cleanup
routines.purpose: Cleans up target enemy stun callback at 0xFF1B60 when anim matches 0x3A

routines.name: ali_cartwheel_chain_finisher
routines.purpose: Tracks cartwheel counter $FF1991 (alternates anim 0x7C/0x7E); on 6th cartwheel triggers Super Finisher (vz 0x40000, elevation 15, state 0x26, anim 0x32, SFX 0x80025B)

routines.name: ali_cartwheel_landing_callback
routines.purpose: Ground stop callback: clears horizontal speed when vz reaches 0

routines.name: ali_air_dive_recovery
routines.purpose: Air dive recovery and frame 24 ground impact shockwave invocation
